# Source: Martyrdom of Saint Cipriano from Heiligenleben (Lives of the Saints), Plate 18 from Woodcuts from Books of the 15th Century

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Martyrdom of Saint Cipriano from Heiligenleben (Lives of the Saints), Plate 18 from Woodcuts from Books of the 15th Century
- **Artist / culture:** Follower of Master of the Boccaccio Illustration (Netherlandish, active c. 1470–1490) printed and published by Konrad Fyner (German, active c. 1473–1483) original text by Jacobus de Voragine (Italian, c. 1230–1298) portfolio text by Wilhelm Ludwig Schreiber (German, 1855–1932)
- **Date:** 1481, portfolio assembled 1929
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** woodcut
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 129318
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/129318
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/a124af14-3efe-312d-390e-39e4e26253d3/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Botanical

## Extracted source palette

`#C8C8B8, #A8A888, #888878, #686858, #C8B898, #484848`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#36362E`
- `surface`: `#4D4D46`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#A8A888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#C8C8B8`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D4D46`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C6C66`
- `error`: `#A8A888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.46:1`, surface `8.01:1`
- Variant contrast: `8.01:1`
- Control contrast: `8.02:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
